title: Scam
body:
This app is extremely misleading and is a scam. I subscribed for $1, was charged $29.99 without clear consent, then even after cancelling, I was charged AGAIN twice (~$34 each).

No transparency, no proper consent. This is not acceptable.

Be very careful before entering your payment details, you may be charged multiple times without realizing.

I will be reporting this and disputing all charges with my bank.

title: It’s an amazing app but…
body:
It needs improvement, like, you give me the first 2 challenges for my morning routine, and then it stops there, you don’t give me another challenge, I have to pick it out myself, and I’m all for that but as someone who is indecisive I shouldn’t have that freedom, I think that you should create a plan for everyone and set goals for us and add challenges wether we like them or not, this we we HAVE to do them instead of just removing them from our challenges list,it doesn’t make it a challenge if we’re able to get rid of it, we start off slow and you help us build our way up, I can’t commit to doing yoga everyday
Because I’m not being told to do it by force
Sometimes force is a good thing
It’s useful
I usually ignore the notifications I get
And when I log in the app I just delete the challenge and pretend like it was never there
That’s not what I want
I want someone to tell me what to do otherwise I’m lost
Please add a plan for people like this
I don’t like having the freedom to choose 
I like following orders 
Especially with things like this
I hope you take this into consideration 
Have a good day.
